hypothesis: The conjunction 'and' is treated as retrieval evidence, inflating unrelated project/task candidates and causing at least one top-k miss. Ignoring only this token will improve ranking precision without reducing model-input recall.
acceptance: No model-input recall regression; reduced false-candidate exposure and/or recovery of sq-04; no brittle case-specific phrase rule.
interpretation: The hypothesis was supported for one ranking failure. The change is general normalization, but the one-case gain is uncertain and seven retrieval queries still miss expected requirements.
